item.title: NASA topples towers used to test Saturn rockets, space shuttle
item.description:
📝 ” The Dynamic Test Stand at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Alabama supported the testing of the first fully assembled Saturn V rocket in 1966 and the first stacked space shuttle in 1978. Credit: NASA The Dynamic Test Stand at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Alabama supported the testing of the first fully assembled Saturn V rocket in 1966 and the first stacked space shuttle in 1978. Credit: NASA Sites and citations The Propulsion and Structural Test Facility and the Dynamic Test Facility were among 19 sites identified for removal at the Marshall Space Flight Center.

item.title: Anthropic has made a large contribution to the Python Software Foundation
item.description:
